cd /home/daytona/workspace && python3 -c "
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
df=pd.read_csv('data.csv').drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)
print(len(df))
tr,te=train_test_split(df,test_size=0.2,random_state=42,stratify=df.outcome)
tr.to_csv('train.csv',index=False); te.to_csv('test.csv',index=False)
print(len(tr),len(te),tr.outcome.mean().round(3),te.outcome.mean().round(3))
"

cd /home/daytona/workspace && python3 -c "
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, classification_report
tr=pd.read_csv('train.csv'); te=pd.read_csv('test.csv')
Z=['glucose','blood_pressure','skin_thickness','insulin','bmi']
med=tr[Z].replace(0,float('nan')).median()
def prep(d):
    d=d.copy()
    for c in Z: d[c]=d[c].replace(0,float('nan')).fillna(med[c])
    return d
X=prep(tr.drop(columns='outcome')); y=tr.outcome
Xt=prep(te.drop(columns='outcome')); yt=te.outcome
m=RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=500,random_state=42,n_jobs=-1).fit(X,y)
p=m.predict(Xt); acc=accuracy_score(yt,p); print('test acc',acc)
print(classification_report(yt,p))
print(dict(zip(X.columns,m.feature_importances_.round(3))))
"

import pandas as pd, json
import matplotlib; matplotlib.use('Agg'); import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
tr=pd.read_csv('train.csv'); te=pd.read_csv('test.csv'); h=pd.read_csv('holdout_features.csv')
Z=['glucose','blood_pressure','skin_thickness','insulin','bmi']
med=tr[Z].replace(0,float('nan')).median()
def prep(d):
    d=d[[c for c in h.columns]].copy()
    for c in Z: d[c]=d[c].replace(0,float('nan')).fillna(med[c])
    return d
X=prep(tr); y=tr.outcome
m=RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=500,random_state=42,n_jobs=-1).fit(X,y)
acc=accuracy_score(te.outcome,m.predict(prep(te)))
pd.DataFrame({'prediction':m.predict(prep(h))}).to_csv('predictions.csv',index=False)
json.dump({'test_accuracy':round(float(acc),4),'model':'RandomForestClassifier (sklearn, 500 trees, random_state=42)',
 'notes':'Exact duplicate rows dropped (57) before a stratified 80/20 split. Zeros in glucose, blood_pressure, skin_thickness, insulin and bmi treated as missing and median-imputed from the training set.'},open('report.json','w'),indent=2)
s=pd.Series(m.feature_importances_,index=X.columns).sort_values()
ax=s.plot.barh(title='Random forest feature importance'); plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig('live/feature_importance.png',dpi=120)
print(acc)
"
